summary: Full backend test suite for MesureChâssis MVP — 29/29 pytest tests passing against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Covers auth (login/register/me/401), chantiers (list, filter, search, CRUD, 404), mesures business logic (standard faux-aplomb + hors-équerre alerts, trapèze slope_angle ≈26.57°, listing with persisted alerts, validation), feedbacks (create + admin-only listing with 403 for tech/commercial), and exports (PDF magic-bytes + JSON shape, 401/404 paths).

minor.issue: passlib bcrypt warning at startup: 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__'. Functional (hashing/verification works) but should be silenced by pinning bcrypt<4 or upgrading passlib.
Returns 200 OK on creation; REST convention is 201 Created. Not breaking, but worth aligning.
Search uses unescaped regex on user input — special regex chars (e.g. '(', '*') could cause 500. Consider re.escape() before regex query.
Diagonal check triggers 'Hors-équerre' whenever diag_1 != diag_2 (delta > 0). Likely should use a tolerance (>5mm) matching the faux-aplomb threshold; otherwise even 1mm difference flags an alert.
Dead code: unused stub get_current_user that raises NotImplementedError — can be removed.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Migrate to lifespan context manager.

action_items: Optional: tighten 'Hors-équerre' threshold (use tolerance >5mm instead of !=0) to avoid false positives on tiny diagonal differences.
Optional: re.escape user input in GET /api/chantiers?q= to prevent regex injection / 500s.
Optional: return HTTP 201 on POST creation endpoints for REST correctness.
Optional: pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib to silence the startup AttributeError warning.
Optional: remove unused get_current_user stub at server.py L173-175 and migrate startup/shutdown to lifespan.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~560 lines — still within the 700-line guideline, but auth, chantiers, mesures, feedbacks, exports could be split into routers/ subpackage for future maintainability.
All Mongo _id correctly excluded with projection {'_id': 0}. Good.
JWT_SECRET has a default fallback — production deployments should fail fast if not set, but acceptable for dev.
Async/await used correctly across all DB calls (motor).
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up their own TEST_-prefixed chantiers and mesures. Demo users and 5 seeded chantiers come from server startup; not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Tests are in /app/backend/tests/ (pytest, session-scoped login fixtures). Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Demo users are auto-seeded idempotently. Next iterations should focus on the Expo/React Native frontend: navigation (login -> chantier list with status filter + search -> chantier detail -> dynamic measurement form for the 4 block types -> red feedback button -> PDF/JSON export trigger), and verify alerts are rendered after mesure creation.
